name: menu-order
description: Restaurant menu and ordering system for Myanmar restaurants

scripts.build: npm run build -w @menu/shared && npm run build -w @menu/api && npm run build -w @menu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @menu/shared && npm run typecheck -w @menu/api && npm run typecheck -w @menu/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @menu/shared" "npm run dev -w @menu/api" "npm run dev -w @menu/web"
